_comment: Pallet Town Composed — genuinely new layout with same content parity

_design_notes.concept: A cozy, organic starter town. The player enters from the south and sees the Pokemon Center immediately to the right. Winding dirt paths lead north through a small park with a pond on the west side, up to Oak's Lab sitting prominently in the town center. Player's house is tucked in the northwest on higher ground, rival's house mirrors it in the northeast. Ranch Pokemon roam the east. Tree clusters break up sight lines and create discovery moments.
_design_notes.dimensions: 55x35 — wider and taller than the original 45x30, giving more breathing room
_design_notes.flow: South entrance -> PokeCenter -> fork: west to park/pond, center to Oak Lab, east to ranch -> north to houses -> north exit to Route 21
